create_api_kserve_v2_engine: create a KServe v2 remote image-classification engine with options, model config, and accelerator settings
initialize_api_kserve_v2_engine: initialize the KServe v2 image-classification engine to load preprocessor, labels, and remote client
run_predict_batch: run inference on a batch of images against a KServe v2 endpoint and return classification outputs
close_api_kserve_v2_engine: close the KServe v2 image-classification engine and release the remote client connection
review_resolve_tensor_names: review the method that resolves input and output tensor names from KServe v2 model metadata
